text:
Alex: @channel :rotating_light: PagerBridge prod heartbeat gap at ~11:23 UTC — pages not leaving. I'm seeing repeated websocket disconnects and 502/504 upstream from notify-gateway. incident-bot didn't escalate, looks like suppressor swallowed pages. Can ops pick this up?

incident-bot: ALERT: pagerbridge-prod heartbeat missing (11m). Suppressed pages: 12. Reason: matching suppressor rule 'quiet-window' — escalation suppressed.

Maya: I'm oncall and not getting pages either. Looking now. Sam Ops, can you pull bridge logs? runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/pagerbridge :eyes:

Sam Ops: grabbing logs. early hint: repeated `ws: read ECONNRESET` and `heartbeat missed` in system log. Trying a restart on node-a first.

Sam Ops: log snippet:
```
Mar 18 11:22:41 pagerbridge[1234]: ws: read ECONNRESET
Mar 18 11:22:42 pagerbridge[1234]: heartbeat check failed: last=11m ago
Mar 18 11:23:05 notify-gateway: upstream 502 for /v1/push
```

Leo: FYI config PR #458 changed the suppressor regex to include `meta.customer=*` — could accidentally match new metadata. Checking the running config now.

Alex: Customer reports coming in from EU (“missed page” tickets). Maya, please do manual paging until automation is healthy. Also need quick impact numbers.

Maya: Doing manual pages now (calling mobiles). Quick impact: ~3 customers reporting missed pages, ~7 total suppressed page events seen in the window. Manual page sent to oncall list.

incident-bot: Manual page recorded: sent by Maya at 11:35 UTC. Note: oncall mapping cache stale for key `oncall:v2` (ttl expired). Token refresh attempt returned 401 earlier — likely prevented auto-paging.

Sam Ops: Restart rolled to 2/3 pods fine, third entered crashloop with 502s from notify-gateway when trying to connect upstream. Rolling back to image `pagerbridge:v1.9.3-back` to restore connections.

Leo: Reverted the suppressor change from PR #458 in live config (removed the new regex). After revert, heartbeat events started returning in the logs on node-a.

Zara: We should add a runbook step: check suppressor and token cache TTL on first triage. Rookie oncall didn't think to check suppressor config. I'll update runbook and add a short training note.

Alex: Good. Opening a postmortem doc: https://redwood/infra/pm/7623456789. Action items: (1) runbook update + training for oncall rookies, (2) fix token auto-refresh to avoid 401 cache gaps, (3) add metric/alert for "suppressed_pages > 5 / 5m", (4) investigate why notify-gateway produced 502s during restart.

Maya: Confirmed customers notified and pages resumed. Closing live mitigation for now — will populate postmortem with timeline and attach logs. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
